NewsArticle.Title: All Contests for Year 2000 are Completed
NewsArticle.Content:
After a large blacklog of contests and working around the various events and updates, all contests for the year 2000 have been judged and placed upon the website. All awards for these contests have been handed out. NOTE: The Event contest has been postponed indefinitely.
The contests for January 2001 will be judged and worked on this month, keeping the contest winners current.
